Threat Event Description: Six SSH connection attempts to 203.0.113.22:22 in six seconds; signature `SSH_BRUTE_FORCE`; edge firewall rate-limited. No successful SSH session is shown.
Immediate Mitigation Action: Keep source rate limit/block in place; verify SSH is not exposed and review authentication logs for the destination.

Threat Event Description: MAC 02:11:22:33:44:55 repeatedly requested leases, triggered an unregistered-device alert, and was declined under rogue-device policy.
Immediate Mitigation Action: Keep the endpoint quarantined from the corporate VLAN; identify owner and inspect NAC/switch records before registration.

Threat Event Description: `j.smith` authenticated from WS-044 / 10.20.4.18, accessed Finance-Restricted, and read `Q4_Budget.xlsx` and `Payroll_Archive.zip`; off-hours sensitive-share alert fired. Successful reads are evidenced, but authorization/context and subsequent copying are unknown.
Severity: Critical — sensitive data access requiring immediate validation
Immediate Mitigation Action: Confirm user and business purpose; contain WS-044 if unauthorized; preserve file/share and endpoint telemetry; review subsequent access/copy/egress activity and revoke sessions if suspicious.

Threat Event Description: `eng02` used direct egress with filtering disabled for curl to high-confidence known C2 198.51.100.200; netflow shows 98,312 outbound bytes and proxy POST 32,768 bytes before firewall block. Suspicious outbound communication is evidenced; payload/content and compromise are unknown.
Severity: Critical — C2 communication and possible data transfer
Immediate Mitigation Action: Isolate 10.20.6.44; maintain egress block; preserve proxy/EDR/NetFlow; investigate process, credentials, and destination; hunt for the indicator enterprise-wide.

Threat Event Description: Anonymous external source queried Kubernetes version and attempted unauthenticated pod creation using `alpine:latest` with a crypto-miner download command. API returned 401, admission denied, and network policy dropped traffic; no pod success is shown.
Immediate Mitigation Action: Confirm no pod/workload was created; retain API audit evidence; block/rate-limit source and verify API endpoint exposure and anonymous access settings.

Threat Event Description: `devuser` attempted to read `/etc/shadow`; repeated failed sudo authentication and `/tmp/.cache/updater` privilege-escalation activity were blocked/denied. No root success is shown.
Immediate Mitigation Action: Isolate or investigate web02; collect the temp binary/script and hashes; review SSH key use, sudo history, and persistence indicators; rotate credentials if unauthorized.

Threat Event Description: Payroll-verification message `msg-81003` had SPF/DKIM/DMARC failures and a high-risk phishing URL; it was quarantined and alerted.
Immediate Mitigation Action: Keep message quarantined; block URL/domain; verify recipient did not access the link via other channels and reset credentials if interaction is found.

Threat Event Description: Source 198.51.100.23 submitted SQL injection patterns against `/products`; first request returned 400 and the retry returned 403 with WAF block. No successful exploit is shown.
Immediate Mitigation Action: Preserve WAF and application records; confirm parameterized queries and inspect for related requests or anomalous database activity.

Threat Event Description: Outlook-launched PowerShell ran an unseen temp script `cache_sync.ps1` with execution-policy bypass/encoded-command behavior and connected to 198.51.100.88:443. EDR quarantined and terminated the process.
Severity: Critical — suspicious execution and outbound connection, contained by EDR
Immediate Mitigation Action: Keep host isolated pending triage; preserve script and memory/EDR telemetry; determine email or download origin, inspect persistence and credentials, and verify quarantine scope.

Threat Event Description: Anonymous/unknown external principal successfully read `corp-finance/client_financials_2026.csv` repeatedly (184,203 bytes per logged read); SIEM marked critical. A bucket policy write was denied. The successful reads indicate potential data exposure; repeated byte counts may represent repeated downloads or duplicate audit records.
Immediate Mitigation Action: Immediately restrict bucket/object access to authenticated principals; preserve CloudTrail and object access logs; revoke anonymous access/credentials and determine actual unique bytes, requester identity, and affected records.

Threat Event Description: 10.20.4.18 issued four long-label TXT queries to `malicious-site.com`; DNS tunnel pattern and suspected exfiltration alerts fired. All answers were NXDOMAIN, so successful transfer is not established. Same source IP is also present in T03; time gap and lack of session evidence leave the linkage uncertain.
Correlated Entities (IPs/Users): 10.20.4.18; `malicious-site.com`; possible WS-044 / j.smith association from T03
Severity: Medium — suspected tunneling/recon, no successful DNS answer shown
Immediate Mitigation Action: Block domain and investigate host 10.20.4.18; correlate resolver, endpoint, and network telemetry around both 03:15 and 12:00; assess whether TXT payloads contained data.

Threat Event Description: `analyst1` enumerated the payments database and attempted to read `credit_cards`; query was denied, followed by rapid-enumeration alert. No rows were returned.
Immediate Mitigation Action: Validate analyst role and ticket; retain DB audit; review surrounding queries and account grants; suspend account if activity is not approved.

Threat Event Description: `it.admin` created `contractor7`, added the account to Helpdesk and Domain Admins; SIEM raised critical alert. `sec.ops` removed Domain Admins membership about 20 seconds later. Privileged exposure occurred briefly; whether intended or compromised is unknown.
Severity: Critical — privileged access change, subsequently reversed
Immediate Mitigation Action: Verify the change with the administrator and change ticket; review contractor7 sign-in/actions during the privilege window; revoke sessions/tokens and rotate credentials if unauthorized.

Threat Event Description: API key `key-7F31` generated 481 product-route requests in a 60-second window, hit rate limits, and was automatically disabled. Scraping is indicated; data volume and authorization are unknown.
Immediate Mitigation Action: Keep key disabled; identify owner and legitimate client; review response/access logs for data accessed and rotate key if exposed.

Threat Event Description: Internet-facing tier-0 `DB-PROD-02` / payments-db runs OpenSSL 3.0.1 vs latest 3.0.14; scanner reports high-confidence active-in-the-wild zero-day CVE-2026-99999 (CVSS 9.8). Patch is overdue and emergency ticket is awaiting action. No exploit event appears in supplied logs.
Severity: Operational Failure — critical exposure, exploitation not evidenced
Immediate Mitigation Action: Apply emergency vendor mitigation/patch; restrict internet access and vulnerable service exposure until fixed; hunt logs for exploitation and validate remediation.

Threat Event Description: Badge E-004182 for Jordan.K was denied at restricted DC-CAGE-04 three times for insufficient clearance; SIEM alert fired and security dispatch acknowledged. No entry was granted.
Correlated Entities (IPs/Users): Jordan.K; badge E-004182; DC-CAGE-04; required DC_CAGE, actual GENERAL_EMPLOYEE
Severity: Medium — repeated unauthorized physical access attempt blocked
Immediate Mitigation Action: Preserve access-control footage/logs; confirm guard response and badge custody; review nearby doors and report any tailgating.
